# Inkdown

Inkdown is a self-hosted markdown workspace: write in a calm editor, organize documents into folders, and publish them with a public link.

## Public pages

- [Home](/): product landing page
- [Privacy](/privacy): privacy policy
- [Terms](/terms): terms of service

## Agent resources

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.md): human-readable site structure
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): install, configure, and use Inkdown as a coding agent
